additional_info.subject: ID0369106-DC/Si-D/BE[170001937] - PowerConverter E:15 CRM:00315001594
additional_info.body:
Hi Lorenz,
I took the initiative since there was no one charging and performed the converter grouping.
As we can see, the converter now doesn't perform the fastshutdown check, previously we could see it since the charger was online and the fastshutdown is only performed at the start up.
As you can see from the very pixelated photo, the Conv[4] didn't get any DC_Output_Voltage as we usually see from any other converter during grouping.
From my perspective it can only be 3 things:
Output cables
Converter is faulty
My recommendation of actions is the following:
Take a spare converter to site
Perform a visual inspection of output cables
Remove them and reinsert them if possible
If this fixes the problem, good
Otherwise, please swap this converter with the neighbour converter and see if the error is still persisting in the same converter which is the following SN:
2102312VGQKXN9001090SA002200000205FW:DC116PF116H100
If the problem persists in the same converter then we have a faulty converter and needs replacement
If the problem is now on the other converter then we should have a wiring issue somewhere between the output cables
As you already scheduled, Thursday I support you remotely.
Thank you and see you on Thursday.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0369106-DC/Si-D/BE[170001937] - PowerConverter E:15 CRM:00315001594
additional_info.body:
Hi Lorenz, good morning. I hope you are doing well and had a nice weekend.
After last week's site visit, we were able to check the Output cables of the converter.
We unplugged and replug them again. There were no visible signs of damage, it's impossible to measure the output while powered on as it is very dangerous.
After the inspection, the converter is working again.
If I have your permission I will close the ticket.
Thank you and have a nice week!
Best regards,
Francisco
